responsibility: Implements gm2’s assembler naming policy for symbols by walking symbol-table scope information and export attributes to build fully qualified names for modules, inner modules, procedures, and ordinary symbols. It decides when module prefixes are required, honors whole-program mode, library-name qualification, monomorphic procedure names, and optional leading C underscores, and returns interned `Name` values suitable for backend declarations and external linkage.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation of M2AsmUtil: it walks symbol scopes and module structure to build full names, applying whole-program mode, export rules, library prefixes, monomorphic-procedure special cases, and C underscore policy. Unlike M2AsmUtil.def, it contains the concrete name-construction policy.
